// Assessment-only collector. It renders the real kit table component in-process.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strings"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/table"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
)

type response struct {
	Path   string              `json:"path"`
	Status int                 `json:"status"`
	Header map[string][]string `json:"header"`
	Body   string              `json:"body"`
}

type packet struct {
	Schema    string     `json:"schema"`
	Responses []response `json:"responses"`
}

func query(theme string) string { return "?" + url.Values{"theme": {theme}}.Encode() }

func tableMarkup(theme string) string {
	rows := []table.Row{
		{ID: "alpha", Cells: []string{"Alpha", "4"}, Href: "./alpha" + query(theme)},
		{ID: "unsafe", Cells: []string{"Unsafe", "7"}, Href: "javascript:void(0)"},
		{ID: "beta", Cells: []string{"Beta", "9"}, Href: "./beta" + query(theme)},
		{ID: "plain", Cells: []string{"No destination", "12"}},
	}
	columns := []table.Column{{Key: "name", Label: "Name"}, {Key: "count", Label: "Count", Align: "right"}}
	var b strings.Builder
	if err := table.Table(table.TableParams{Columns: columns, Rows: rows, Caption: "Synthetic table-link task"}).Render(context.Background(), &b); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func shell(theme, title, content string) string {
	dataTheme := ""
	if theme != "" {
		dataTheme = ` data-theme="` + template.HTMLEscapeString(theme) + `"`
	}
	return `<!doctype html><html lang="en"` + dataTheme + `><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>` + template.HTMLEscapeString(title) + `</title><meta name="description" content="Synthetic table-link accessibility task"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/app.css"></head><body class="bg-surface-sunken font-sans text-ink"><main id="table-links-main" class="mx-auto max-w-5xl p-4 sm:p-8">` + content + `</main></body></html>`
}

func listPage(theme string) string {
	return shell(theme, "Table links fixture", `<p class="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-ink-muted">Synthetic kit control</p><h1 class="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">Table links fixture</h1><p class="mt-3 max-w-prose text-sm text-ink-muted">Valid destinations, an unsafe destination and a row without a destination. No scripts are required.</p><section class="mt-8" aria-labelledby="table-links-heading"><h2 id="table-links-heading" class="text-lg font-semibold">Service rows</h2>`+tableMarkup(theme)+`</section>`)
}

func detailPage(theme, name string) string {
	return shell(theme, name+" detail", `<a href="/table-links`+query(theme)+`" class="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-accent underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Back to list</a><h1 class="mt-6 text-2xl font-semibold">`+template.HTMLEscapeString(name)+` detail</h1><p class="mt-3 text-sm text-ink-muted">Synthetic destination reached from the table-link task.</p>`)
}

func collect(h http.Handler, path string) response {
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://127.0.0.1"+path, nil))
	headers := make(map[string][]string, len(w.Header()))
	for key, values := range w.Header() {
		headers[key] = append([]string(nil), values...)
	}
	return response{Path: path, Status: w.Code, Header: headers, Body: w.Body.String()}
}

func main() {
	h := gallery.New()
	responses := []response{}
	for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
		for _, path := range []string{"/table-links", "/alpha", "/beta"} {
			full := path + query(theme)
			if path == "/table-links" {
				responses = append(responses, response{Path: full, Status: http.StatusOK, Header: map[string][]string{"Content-Type": {"text/html; charset=utf-8"}, "Content-Security-Policy": {"default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'"}}, Body: listPage(theme)})
			} else {
				responses = append(responses, response{Path: full, Status: http.StatusOK, Header: map[string][]string{"Content-Type": {"text/html; charset=utf-8"}, "Content-Security-Policy": {"default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'"}}, Body: detailPage(theme, strings.TrimPrefix(path, "/"))})
			}
		}
	}
	responses = append(responses, collect(h, "/static/app.css"))
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(packet{Schema: "appkit-table-links-v1", Responses: responses}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
